question: A and B can complete a piece of work in 12 days. B and C can complete the same work in 15 days and C and A in 10 days. How many days will A take to complete the work by himself?
solution:

A and B can complete a piece of work in 12 days.

B and C can complete the same work in 15 days.

C and A can complete the same work in 10 days.

Work done by A, B, and C together = Work done by (A + B) + Work done by (B + C) + Work done by (C + A) - 2 × (Work done by A + Work done by B + Work done by C)
